title: Pure Dinowrestler
summary: Pure Dinowrestler Dinosaur board-breaking and battle control build with generic Links and staples. Dinowrestlers Special Summon themselves when the opponent controls more monsters, punish multi-monster boards, and lock down the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters & Extenders
points: Dinowrestler Systegosaur searches any Dinowrestler monster or World Dino Wrestling when Special Summoned, and revives a Dinowrestler from the GY in the End Phase if the opponent controls more monsters.

Dinowrestler Iguanodraka discards a Dinosaur to Special Summon itself from the hand, then Tributes a Dinosaur to Special Summon a Dinowrestler with a different original name from the GY in Defense Position.
Dinowrestler Pankratops Special Summons itself from the hand while the opponent controls more monsters, and Tributes a Dinowrestler as a Quick Effect to destroy any card the opponent controls.
Dinowrestler Coelasilat Special Summons itself as a Level 2 Tuner onto an empty field, and Dinowrestler Valeonyx Special Summons itself when the opponent controls a Link-3 or higher monster.

summary.title: Opening / Going-Second Line: Iguanodraka + Systegosaur
steps: Discard Dinowrestler Systegosaur or another Dinosaur to Special Summon Dinowrestler Iguanodraka from the hand, then Tribute Iguanodraka to revive Systegosaur from the GY.
Systegosaur's Special Summon effect searches World Dino Wrestling or Dinowrestler Pankratops.

Link Summon Dinowrestler Terra Parkourio to recover a Dinowrestler from the GY and climb into Dinowrestler King T Wrextle, or use Dinowrestler Coelasilat to Synchro Summon Dinowrestler Giga Spinosavate.

summary.title: World Dino Wrestling & Martial Handtraps
summary.text: World Dino Wrestling restricts each player to attacking with only 1 monster per Battle Phase while you control a Dinowrestler, and can banish itself from the GY while the opponent controls more monsters to Special Summon any Dinowrestler such as Systegosaur directly from the Deck. In battle, Dinowrestler Martial Ampelo discards itself to prevent a battling Dinowrestler from being destroyed and halve the battle damage, then banishes itself from the GY when an opponent's monster declares an attack to search a Dinowrestler. Dinowrestler Martial Anga discards itself when an opponent's monster attacks your Dinowrestler to keep it alive and end the Battle Phase.

summary.title: Bosses, Fusion & Left out
points: Dinowrestler King T Wrextle (Link-3) stops the opponent from activating Spells or Traps until the end of the Damage Step when it battles, and at the start of the opponent's Battle Phase it forces them to attack King T Wrextle first with a chosen monster or lose that monster.

Tyrant Dino Fusion Quick-Play Fusion Summons Dinowrestler Chimera T Wrextle with one-time destruction protection; Chimera T Wrextle inflicts piercing damage, stops responses in battle, and wipes all opposing Attack Position monsters if destroyed by card effect.

Dinowrestler Giga Spinosavate (Level 8 Synchro) destroys a monster on the field once per turn, stops Spells and Traps in battle, and destroys another card you control instead if it would be destroyed.

Dinowrestler Capaptera sends an opponent's monster to the GY when they control more monsters, Eskrimamenchi Normal Summons without Tributes and revives a Dinowrestler when the opponent Special Summons, and Rambrachio protects other Dinowrestlers from targeting.
Left out: The page's external Dinosaur engine is omitted so this list stays pure Dinowrestler.
